  (SELECT gmv FROM g WHERE yr=2018) AS gmv_2018,

{"sql": "SELECT p.payment_installments AS mode_installments,
       COUNT(*) AS payment_records,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 4) AS share_pct
FROM order_payments p
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
WHERE p.payment_type = 'credit_card'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY p.payment_installments
ORDER BY payment_records DESC, mode_installments
LIMIT 5"}

  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status='delivered'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
), agg AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         count(*) AS measured_orders,
         count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date) AS late_orders,
         100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date)/nullif(count(*),0) AS late_pct
  FROM d GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT seller_id, measured_orders, late_orders, late_pct
FROM agg WHERE measured_orders >= 50
ORDER BY late_pct DESC, seller_id
LIMIT 10;"}

{"sql": "WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, count(oi.order_item_id) AS items
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS orders_with_items,
       sum(items) AS total_items,
       round(avg(items), 4) AS avg_items,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE items >= 2) AS multi_item_orders,
       round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE items >= 2) / count(*), 4) AS multi_item_pct
FROM o;"}
